name: Wall Air Conditioner
summary: Wall-mounted split air conditioner with a louvre and airflow lines; anim blow makes the cool air flow down.

params.name: y
params.note: wall item: centred on y (default 760), no ground shadow

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 matches real size (about 520 px wide)

params.name: airflow
params.note: true = airflow lines below the louvre

params.name: anim
params.note: blow = the airflow lines travel down

author: krakujs
